text:
pat: Quick midweek broadcast — introducing micro-rollout mode for selected services and a short embargo on schema changes for this train. Please ack.

pat: TL;DR: micro-rollouts allow 10% -> 50% -> 100% staged traffic ramps with metric checks between stages. Schema changes embargo: no schema-altering migrations within 18h of freeze unless emergency.

pat: Canary window for this sprint: Wed 23:30-03:30 UTC. Freeze still Sat 00:00 - Mon 06:00 UTC.

pat: Required preflip checklist (short):
- run `ci/smoke` and `ci/perf-sample`
- mark PRs with `release:micro` to opt into micro-rollout path
- include a 1-line canary status when flipping

iolanda: Ack. How do we opt a service into micro-rollout?

pat: Add label `release:micro` on the PR and include expected token-rate and stage durations in the PR body. Eng-sre will schedule ramp if approved.

fran: We have a small config migration. Should we move it?

pat: Yes, any schema/config migration that touches user-visible state should avoid the embargo window. Move to the next calm window or request exception with mitigation.

ops-bot: CI updated for train-1812: added `check:micro-rollout` and `check:stage-metrics`. :gear:

release-bot: Policy note: reverting micro-rollout defaults or lifting embargo requires written approval from release leads and eng-sre. See /policies/release-train.

fran: Can we have an example one-line canary status?

pat: Sure: `canary=8891 | service=embed-svc | state=up | stage=10% | t=15m | p95=420ms | err=0.2%`. Keep it single line in the thread.

eng-sre-bot: Observability change: sampling for traces increased for micro-rollout services during stage windows. Expect more traces in APM.

iolanda: Noted. Any change to opt-out for emergency patches?

ops-bot: Emergency opt-out CLI unchanged but faster ack:
```
/optout release-gates --reason "urgent-fix" --owner @you
```
Requires ops in-thread approval within 25m; audit logged.

fran: PR #5410 labeled `release:micro` and running `ci/perf-sample`.

pat: thanks. Action items: owners label PRs and run smoke, eng-sre watch staged metrics and traces, release leads approve exceptions in-thread. I'll post a short changelog tomorrow with micro-rollout outcomes and any embargo exceptions. Ping @pat or escalate in #eng-oncall if blocked.
